s1.syndrome_frame: Gradually enlarging soft-tissue mass over the dorsum of the hand with a history of prior malignancy
salient_findings: 2-month history of a gradually enlarging mass
Soft-tissue mass over the second metacarpal dorsum with mild tenderness
Presence of Reed–Sternberg–like cells in an inflammatory background
key_facts: 25-year-old man
History of Hodgkin lymphoma
Diagnosed with Hodgkin lymphoma 6 years earlier
Received 13 courses of chemotherapy
Mass located over the dorsum of the left hand
Mass measures approximately 4 cm in greatest dimension
Mild tenderness but no limitation of movement
Microscopic examination shows a mixture of inflammatory cells and myxoid stroma
Presence of epithelioid and spindle-shaped cells, lipoblast-like cells, and occasional Reed–Sternberg–like cells

differentials: Giant cell tumor of soft tissue
per_call: Giant cell tumor of soft tissue

shortlist.label: Myxoinflammatory fibroblastic sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches the clinical presentation of a gradually enlarging soft-tissue mass with mild tenderness and presence of myxoid stroma, epithelioid and spindle-shaped cells, and lipoblast-like cells

shortlist.label: Acral myxoinflammatory fibroblastic sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Specific subtype of myxoinflammatory fibroblastic sarcoma that typically occurs on the acral sites, consistent with the location of the mass on the dorsum of the hand

shortlist.label: Myxoid liposarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of myxoid stroma and lipoblast-like cells, which are characteristic of myxoid liposarcoma

shortlist.label: Hodgkin lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's history of Hodgkin lymphoma and presence of Reed-Sternberg-like cells, which are characteristic of Hodgkin lymphoma

shortlist.label: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of Reed-Sternberg-like cells and a history of prior malignancy, which could suggest a lymphoma, and anaplastic large cell lymphoma is a type of lymphoma that can present with systemic symptoms and masses

raw.rationale: The mass is located over the dorsum of the hand, which is a characteristic location for acral myxoinflammatory fibroblastic sarcoma, and the microscopic examination shows a mixture of inflammatory cells, myxoid stroma, and various cell types consistent with this diagnosis

rejected.label: Myxoinflammatory fibroblastic sarcoma
rejected.why: While similar, the specific location of the mass suggests a more specific diagnosis of acral myxoinflammatory fibroblastic sarcoma

rejected.label: Myxoid liposarcoma
rejected.why: The presence of Reed-Sternberg-like cells and the mixture of cell types are not typical of myxoid liposarcoma

rejected.label: Hodgkin lymphoma
rejected.why: The patient's history of Hodgkin lymphoma and the presence of Reed-Sternberg-like cells could suggest recurrence, but the clinical presentation and microscopic findings are more consistent with a soft tissue tumor

rejected.label: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma
rejected.why: The microscopic examination does not show the characteristic large anaplastic cells of this lymphoma
